note: The digital witness has one declared corrigendum, confirmed against the 1962 printed page. Its j-spellings are recorded as orthographic variants.

adjudicated.ruling: The printed Missal uses i; the digital witness uses j for the same Latin word.
Witness do spells Judǽi with consonantal j; the edition prints Iudǽi as the typical edition does (ORTHOGRAPHY rule 2).
